events.text: Before 09:00 IST now (03:28), so the scheduled run hasn't fired. I'll make the LOG line idempotent per day so kickstarting now and the 09:00 run don't double-log, then kickstart.

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly; echo rc=$?; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ -f workshop-plan/pipeline/snapshots/2026-10-12.json ] && break; sleep 3; done; ls workshop-plan/pipeline/snapshots/; tail -8 workshop-plan/pipeline/weekly.log; grep -c "^2026-10-12 .*PIPELINE WEEKLY SNAPSHOT" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md

events.text: Found the cause: the snapshot is dated in UTC, so the Monday 09:00 IST run files itself as Sunday (2026-10-11). Also PR lookups fail under launchd. Checking both.

events.text: Two causes: `day` comes from a UTC clock (Monday 09:00 IST is Sunday 03:30 UTC), and under launchd's bare PATH the gh wrapper can't find the real gh. Fixing both in dash.py.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply local-date and gh PATH fixes, test PR refresh

events.input: $ cd /tmp; env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin /Users/adithyamurali/.config/tantra/agent-bin/gh api repos/Usetantra/tantra-backend-v2/pulls/160 --jq .state 2>&1 | head -3; ls /opt/homebrew/bin/gh /usr/local/bin/gh 2>&1; type -a gh

events.text: Real gh lives in `~/.local/bin`. Adding that to the PATH.

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/pipeline; sed -i '' 's#+ ":/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin"}#+ ":" + os.path.expanduser("~/.local/bin") + ":/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin"}#' dash.py; grep -n 'local/bin")' dash.py | cut -c1-80; env -i HOME=$HOME /usr/bin/python3 dash.py prs 2>&1 | tail -1
